senses.gloss:
त्सर् त्सर्, cl. 1. P. त्सरति, तत्सार, त्सरि-
ष्यति, अत्सारीत् and अत्सार्, त्सरितुम्, Ved.
to go or approach stealthily, to creep, crawl, creep
on, steal upon, sneak, to obtain by sneaking; to
proceed crookedly or fraudulently.

त्सरु, उस्, m. any creeping or crawling animal or
a particular animal of this kind; the stalk of a leaf
&c.; the hilt or handle of a sword and similar
weapons.
—त्सरु-मार्ग, अस्, m. sword-exercise,
sword-fight.

त्सारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. creeping, sneaking, ap-
proaching stealthily or secretly; crooked; (Sāy.)
very fearful, very much alarmed.

त्सारुक, अस्, आ, अम्, skilful in handling a sword,
skilled in sword-exercise.
